intro: Fresh Avocado is a premium topping available on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) that adds creamy richness to any bowl or pita. Made from fresh sliced Hass avocado, this topping delivers healthy fats and smooth texture. At 110 calories, it transforms your meal into a more satisfying Mediterranean experience. Explore the [full CAVA menu](//) to discover perfect pairings for this popular add-on.
priceCalories: Fresh Avocado costs an additional $1.95 to $2.45 depending on your location and portion size. This premium topping contains 110 calories per serving, making it a nutrient-dense addition to your customized bowl or pita. The price reflects the quality of fresh Hass avocados prepared daily. Check our [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete meal totals.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Fresh Avocado apart is its use of premium Hass avocados, known for their buttery texture and superior flavor. Unlike pre-mashed options, CAVA serves fresh slices that maintain peak freshness and visual appeal. The creamy consistency perfectly complements Mediterranean flavors found across the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). This topping adds restaurant-quality ingredients to your customized creation.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Fresh Avocado provides 110 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile: 10g of healthy fats, 6g of carbohydrates, and 1g of protein. The fat content consists primarily of heart-healthy monounsaturated fats that support overall wellness. This topping adds nutritional value without excessive calories. Visit the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for detailed dietary information about this and other ingredients.
whatsInside: Fresh Avocado contains just one simple ingredient: fresh sliced Hass avocado. There are no preservatives, additives, or artificial ingredients involved. The avocados are carefully selected for ripeness and sliced fresh to order. This clean ingredient list makes it suitable for various dietary preferences. The simplicity ensures you get pure avocado flavor and nutrition in every bite.
tasteLike: Fresh Avocado delivers a smooth, buttery taste with subtle nutty undertones that enhance any Mediterranean dish. The creamy texture melts into warm grains and proteins, creating a luxurious mouthfeel. The mild flavor does not overpower other ingredients but rather complements bold spices and tangy dressings. Each slice maintains its integrity while adding richness. The fresh preparation ensures optimal taste and texture in every serving.
customize: Add Fresh Avocado to any creation from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) through the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings). Pair it with Shredded Romaine for added crunch or Tomato + Onion for fresh contrast. The topping works beautifully with both grain bowls and pita wraps. Layer it with other premium toppings or keep your bowl simple. The customization options allow you to create your perfect Mediterranean meal.
pairsWell: Fresh Avocado pairs exceptionally well with Shredded Romaine (5 cal), Tomato + Onion (20 cal), and Sumac Cabbage Slaw (30 cal) for a refreshing combination. Add Pita Crisps (70 cal) for textural contrast against the creamy avocado. The topping complements spicy harissa or tangy lemon herb tahini dressings. It balances bold flavors from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) selections perfectly.
healthyChoice: Fresh Avocado qualifies as an excellent healthy choice, providing monounsaturated fats that support heart health and nutrient absorption. The 10g of healthy fats help you feel satisfied longer while adding minimal carbohydrates. Avocados contain fiber, potassium, and vitamins that contribute to overall wellness. This topping fits seamlessly into keto, paleo, and Mediterranean diet patterns. Check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) to build a complete nutritious meal.
howToOrder: To order Fresh Avocado, build your bowl or pita and select it from the toppings section. Specify if you want a regular or extra portion, which affects the additional charge. The topping can be added to any base, main protein, or dip combination. Ask staff to place it strategically for optimal distribution. Order online or in-store for the same fresh quality and customization options.
vsAlternatives: Compared to included toppings like Shredded Romaine or Tomato + Onion, Fresh Avocado offers superior creaminess and healthy fats at a premium price. While other toppings add crunch or acidity, avocado provides richness and substance. The 110 calories deliver more satiety than lower-calorie alternatives. Unlike dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads), avocado adds whole-food nutrition. The investment enhances your meal significantly.
whoShouldTry: Fresh Avocado appeals to health-conscious diners seeking nutrient-dense toppings that elevate their meal. Avocado lovers will appreciate the quality of fresh Hass avocado slices over processed alternatives. Those following keto, paleo, or plant-forward diets benefit from its healthy fat content. Anyone wanting to add creaminess without dairy should try this topping. First-time visitors exploring the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) will enjoy this upgrade.
worthTrying: Fresh Avocado is absolutely worth the additional $1.95 to $2.45 for the quality and nutritional benefits it provides. The fresh Hass avocado transforms ordinary bowls into restaurant-quality meals with superior taste and texture. The healthy fats increase satiety, potentially making your meal more satisfying. Frequent CAVA visitors consistently rate this as a favorite premium topping. The investment enhances both flavor and nutrition significantly.

faqs.q: How much does Fresh Avocado cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Fresh Avocado costs an additional $1.95 to $2.45 depending on your location and portion size. This premium topping is not included in the base price but adds significant value through quality Hass avocado slices. The price varies slightly by market but remains consistent within each region.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Fresh Avocado?
faqs.a: CAVA Fresh Avocado contains 110 calories per standard serving. The macronutrient breakdown includes 10g of healthy fats, 6g of carbohydrates, and 1g of protein. These calories come primarily from heart-healthy monounsaturated fats that provide nutritional benefits and increased satiety for your meal.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Fresh Avocado gluten-free and vegan?
faqs.a: Yes, Fresh Avocado is both gluten-free and vegan, containing only fresh sliced Hass avocado with no additives. This makes it suitable for various dietary restrictions including vegetarian, vegan, paleo, and keto diets. The simple ingredient list ensures compatibility with most allergen concerns and eating preferences.

faqs.q: What type of avocado does CAVA use?
faqs.a: CAVA uses fresh Hass avocados, which are known for their creamy texture and rich, buttery flavor. Hass avocados are considered the premium variety with superior taste compared to other avocado types. The avocados are sliced fresh to maintain optimal texture and presentation in your bowl or pita.

faqs.q: Can I get extra Fresh Avocado on my CAVA bowl?
faqs.a: Yes, you can request extra Fresh Avocado when ordering your CAVA bowl or pita. The additional portion will incur an extra charge beyond the standard premium topping price. Simply inform the staff or select the extra option when customizing your order online for increased avocado content.
